units.source_text: 女子从窗台上站起来，又轻柔地坐在窗前的铺席上。

en.t: The woman rose from the windowsill, then sat down gently on the mat in front of the window.

units.source_text: 她那副样子，好像是在回顾遥远的往昔，才忽然坐到岛村身边的。

en.t: She looked as if she had suddenly come to sit beside Shimamura only after looking back on the distant past.
